title: PG-02.1 CRDT conformance gate (history-based, CI) (crdt-merge)
request: Programme contract for work package WP02 in crdt-merge: CRDT conformance gate (history-based, CI). Proposed and unsigned; the signer (ASTL workstream) signs it after the red-team gate. Source: the programme decomposition of 31 Oct 2026 (docs/scope-one/programme/WBS.md, docs/scope-one/programme/DECOMPOSITION.md, docs/scope-one/programme/fragments/WP02.json) and the owner notes behind docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md. Depends on tasks outside this contract: WP01-01, WP01-02. Covers only what the Scope One contracts (SO-1.01 to SO-1.11) do not already cover; the mapping is in contracts/programme/manifest.json. Owner decisions of 31 Oct 2026 apply: crdt-merge stays in its own repository and is reached only across the WO-05-A call-out boundary (never vendored, no memev-merge); tiers are free core, Personal at $12/month or $120/year for up to 3 computers, and contact us above that; there is no Federated tier.
